A student investigated the effect of temperature on the time taken for beans to germinate.
The student:
• planted 200 beans in trays containing soil, and kept them at 10 °C
• added 45 cm of water to the trays each day
• recorded the time when each bean started to germinate
• calculated the mean time for germination
• repeated the procedure at 20 °C, 30 °C, 40 °C and 50 °C.
